name: Caldes de Malavella (Spain)
description: Red field with a white vertical stripe of one third of the length at the hoist, charged at the upper hoist with a red canton bearing two white wavy fesses.
history: The flag was approved on 28 February 1996 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2183 of 18 March 1996; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with a white vertical stripe of 1/3 of the length at the hoist, within which an imaginary rectangle at the canton bears the waves of the arms.

features.role: two wavy fesses on the canton
